export_evidence: ImportKey India customs record, BOL 8498505, date 2026-01-05: "BARFLEX POLYFILMS LIMITED | POKHARA PACKGING INDUSTRIES PVT | PVC FILM- | SONAULI LCS INSNLB, India | Bhairawa, NEPAL | 39201092 | 8498505" — one export shipment to Nepal, HS 39201092 (PVC film), dated 05.01.2026. Source counter: ImportKey page for BARFLEX POLYFILMS LIMITED reports "Total Shipments 40 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 2"; of those 40 rows only 5 individual records were rendered in the free view, and only 1 of them is an export (the other 4 are imports from China/Taiwan). Buyer list shows "2 POKHRA PACKAGING INDUSTRIES PVT.LTD" and "1 POKHARA PACKGING INDUSTRIES PVT" — i.e. 2-3 export rows to the same Nepali buyer, only one with a visible BOL number and date.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. Tofler company page returned 404 (https://www.tofler.in/barflex-polyfilms-limited/company), Eximpedia and Volza returned HTTP 403, and the web_search tool was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session, so no domestic-supply record was located. Not evidence of absence — evidence not obtained.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: one dated customs line (05.01.2026, Sonauli LCS → Bhairawa, Nepal, HS 39201092, BOL 8498505) shows Barflex as supplier to Pokhara Packaging Industries. Direction is overwhelmingly inbound though — of the 5 visible rows, 4 are imports (BOPA film from Dezhou Donghong, rotogravure printing machines from Zhejiang Fangbang / Hong Kong Anruida), which is consistent with a converter that buys film and machinery and sells finished film. Declared HS set (390110;392020;392190;392310) does not match the observed export line 39201092 (PVC film) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the actual code should be recorded as 39201092 (and 39209219 for BOPA imports). Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure found, not estimated. Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than none_found because the lookup failed on tooling, not because the company was searched and came up empty. No CIN/PAN verified in this pass.
